summaryZh: Stellar Dynamics & Compact Objects Group 研究恒星动力学与致密天体物理的联系。方向包括致密星团 N 体模拟、引力波中的致密双星和潮汐瓦解事件、快速射电暴等高能暂现现象。

evidence.quote: Stellar Dynamics & Compact Objects Group at UC San Diego

Areas of expertise include N-body simulations of dense stellar clusters, detection of compact object binaries via gravitational waves (LIGO & LISA), and high-energy transient phenomena such as tidal disruption events and fast radio bursts.
